events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day, we mark the anniversary of Oasis's debut album 'Definitely Maybe', which was originally released on August 29, 1994, becoming the fastest-selling debut album in British history.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Flashback
angles.copy: Twenty-two years ago today, we're looking back at the album that started it all for Oasis. 'Definitely Maybe' dropped and changed the game. What's your top track from the debut?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on August 15, 1969, in Bethel, New York, drawing over 400,000 attendees for three days of peace, love, and music.

angles.name: Woodstock Remembered
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, a legendary festival kicked off. Three days of music and counter-culture that defined a generation. Which Woodstock performance is etched in your memory?

events.title: Elvis Presley Death Anniversary
events.blurb: On August 16, 1977, the world mourned the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, at the age of 42 at his Graceland home.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago, we lost a true icon. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to shake, rattle, and roll. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Today, we celebrate the 75th birthday of American-British singer, songwriter, and Pretenders frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, born in Akron, Ohio, in 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Raising a glass to Chrissie Hynde, the incomparable voice of The Pretenders, celebrating her 75th birthday today. Still rocking after all these years!

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Born in Manchester in 1972, the iconic frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our kid is another year older! Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem he sang?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated globally as James Bond Day, marking the release of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating the enduring legacy of 007 since 'Dr. No' premiered in '62. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're taking a moment to remember the visionary, John Lennon. His music and message still resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer, John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today, born in Weston-super-Mare in 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.
